text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads up 11 Helios sent final assets for a marketplace tile + 1-pager. Need quick review: logo variants, hero crop, tile copy, and export sizes. Aim to list Wed next week. Drive: https://drive.company/helios-redwood-case

assets-bot: Uploaded: helios_brand_ok.pdf, helios_visuals_final.zip, helios_case_appendix.csv

Sam (Design): Viewing now. Helios provided circular mark + stacked wordmark. Recommendation: circular mark on the 1200x600 tile, full wordmark on the PDF header.

Zoe (Brand Ops): We'll need SVGs with 16px clearspace and PNG @1x/@2x. Also request white mono for dark backgrounds and a flat treatment (no shadows).

Olivia (Helios PM): Confirmed brand approval doc in the Drive (helios_brand_ok.pdf). Use primary accent #0B74FF and the photon gradient for the hero overlay (guidelines in Drive).

Kai (Marketing): Draft tile headline: "Helios + Redwood: 3x inference cost reduction for GenAI" Short blurb: "How Helios cut per-token spend by routing cold workloads to Redwood Dedicated while keeping p95 latency <150ms." CTA: "Read case study"

James (Legal): If we state "3x reduction" we need the appendix numbers. I'll check the helios_case_appendix.csv and mark if anything needs softening. Also need screenshot anonymization (mask emails).

Maya (Partnerships): Appendix exists. James, please aim to sign off by Thursday EOD.

Sam (Design): I'll produce two layout options: left-image/text-right and full-bleed hero overlay. Export presets: 1200x600 @1x png, 2400x1200 @2x png, 600x300 webp, thumb 300x150 png.

Zoe (Brand Ops): Also provide alt text and 140-char metadata one-liner for marketplace search. I'll bundle brand files once Sam confirms placements.

Olivia (Helios PM): Helios prefers full-bleed hero. Screenshots are fine but please blur customer names and mask emails. Alt text suggestion: "Helios dashboard showing model throughput with Redwood routing overlay" CTA URL: https://helios.com/redwood-case

Sam (Design): Uploaded Figma mock -> https://figma.com/file/helios-tile-mock#version2. Exported SVGs to Drive (helios_exports/). Removed drop shadow on dark logo per Helios. Added alt text to assets.

James (Legal): Quick review done 1 minor phrasing change in the intro and one note about calling out "3x". Not blocking. I'll place comments in the doc.

Kai (Marketing): I'll write the marketplace metadata and 1-pager hero copy by Thu noon. Proposed 140-char line: "Helios & Redwood reduce GenAI inference costs while keeping sub-150ms latency  read the case study."

Zoe (Brand Ops): Approved the exported files layout. One ask: keep 40px minimum clearspace around the mark.

Maya (Partnerships): Timeline: mocks Thu AM, legal Thu PM, final assets Fri, queue listing Mon for Wed launch. Everyone good?

James (Legal): OK. Prioritizing Thu afternoon review.

Olivia (Helios PM): Helios approves final visuals.

Kai (Marketing): :thumbsup: I'll schedule the listing and social snippets post-publish. Need final CTA URL from Maya before scheduling.

Maya (Partnerships): CTA is Olivia's link. I'll post final asset links in the partnership repo after publish. Thanks team, closing thread.
